c74object.name: el.clickhold~
c74object.digest: Sample and hold triggered by non-zero signal values
c74object.description:
el.clickhold~ is a streamlined sample-and-hold object. Unlike sah~, which requires separate signal and trigger inputs with a threshold parameter, el.clickhold~ operates on a single audio stream: whenever a non-zero sample arrives, its value is captured and held continuously at the output until the next non-zero sample is received.
Inlets
Inlet 1 (signal): Trigger and value input. Any non-zero sample updates the held output value. Zero samples leave the held value unchanged.
Outlets
Outlet 1 (signal): Held output signal. Continuously outputs the most recent non-zero sample value received.

inlet.description: Incoming audio stream. Any non-zero sample updates the held output value.

outlet.description: Outputs a continuous signal equal to the most recent non-zero input sample.

method.name: signal
method.description: Monitored on a sample-by-sample basis. Whenever an incoming sample is non-zero, it updates the held output signal.
